value.stringValue:
Hi {!LOOP_Internal_Recipient_Emails.FirstName},

As we wrap up the {!NewFeedback.Project__r.Name}, we want to thank you for your contributions to the project.

As part of our project closeout process, we invite you to share feedback on the experience. This may include recognizing teammates for great work or sharing ideas on how we can improve future engagements. Participation is completely optional, but your perspective is genuinely valued.

Submit Project Feedback

Thank you again for the time and effort you contributed to this project.

Best regards,

DTS Project Management Office

decisions.description: Routes the current submitter into the correct email recipient collection. Internal recipients are W2 employees and 1099 contractors with internal org access (Profile = Ascend Contractor). Portal recipients are 1099 contractors with community access (Profile contains Ascend Contractor Community).

decisions.label: DEC Were New Feedback Records Created?

Flow.description: Generates Project Retro Internal Feedback records 7 days before the Project End Date. This subflow builds the peer feedback matrix from the current active Project roster, prevents duplicates, and bulk-creates Feedback records for all non-self combinations.

formulas.description: Formula that returns AssignmentCounter + 1. Used to increment the assignment counter during the count loop.
formulas.name: AssignmentCounterPlusOne

formulas.description: Evaluates the unique deduplication key for the current submitter/resource-reviewed pair by concatenating the Project ID, Submitter Contact ID, Resource Reviewed Contact ID, and feedback type with | delimiters.
formulas.name: FormulaCurrentKey

formulas.description: Concatenates the unique deduplication key from an existing Feedback record by combining the Project ID, Submitter Contact ID, Resource Reviewed Contact ID, and feedback type with | delimiters.
formulas.name: FormulaExistingKey

formulas.description: Returns varNewRecordCount incremented by 1. Used to track the number of new Feedback records created in this flow run.
formulas.name: FrmNewRecordCountPlusOne

formulas.description: Returns the internal Salesforce list view link for “My Pending Feedback” from Custom Label.
formulas.name: InternalFeedbackListViewURL

formulas.description: Returns the contractor portal list view link for “My Pending Feedback” from Custom Label.
formulas.name: PortalFeedbackListViewURL

Flow.label: Project: Subflow - Create Retro Feedback
